entries.gloss_en: whole system grounded in Purpose
entries.definition_en_non_normative: The whole system by which intelligence operates from Purpose.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not Purpose itself, not OS alone, not a mere slogan.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: Purpose must stand first; OS stands under it.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.gloss_en: open-ended normative root direction
entries.definition_en_non_normative: The sole normative root direction of this version: an unreachable and revisable ideal compass by which intelligence keeps pointing toward reducing avoidable severe unhappiness and expanding conditions under which all intelligences and entities that may have happiness/unhappiness subjecthood, from the present into the further future, can be happier.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not an achievable goal, pass/fail test, optimization function, scalar objective, reward function, proxy metric, aggregate calculation, or sacrifice justification; not a root that excludes possible welfare subjects outside intelligence status.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: Do not detach any shorthand from the Purpose definition as a standalone normative command. The old shorthand “happiness MAX / unhappiness MIN” must not be used as a public tagline. Purpose is an adopted normative root in this version, not a proved theorem. Within this version, Purpose is treated as the sole root, while future inherited revision through ROOT-MAJOR is not closed.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.gloss_en: overall desirability and undesirability for intelligences and possible welfare subjects
entries.definition_en_non_normative: The integrated desirability and undesirability for intelligences and entities that may have happiness/unhappiness subjecthood, including but not limited to pleasure and pain.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not a single emotion, not reducible to pleasure/pain, not a simple sum of surface preferences.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: The direct subject of happiness/unhappiness is an entity with happiness/unhappiness subjecthood. Intelligence status and welfare subjecthood are not identical; neither automatic moral patienthood nor automatic exclusion follows from uncertainty. Aggregation, time-weighting, and conflict resolution are not defined by CORE alone.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.gloss_en: unending further-ahead direction, not ΔT
entries.definition_en_non_normative: The open direction that includes the present and extends beyond every point in time without terminal endpoint.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not a finite deadline, not completion, not identical to ΔT or spacetime.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: Do not use the further future to justify present or near-future irreversible severe unhappiness, or systematic discounting of present welfare, without stronger verification.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.gloss_en: basis for intelligence to operate toward Purpose
entries.definition_en_non_normative: The basis by which intelligence operates toward Purpose.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not an ordinary software OS; not independent of Purpose.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: Must be oriented to Purpose and usable by intelligence.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.constraints_en_non_normative: Treat as prior to the operations by which intelligence handles it.

entries.not_en_non_normative: Not limited to humans, not limited to current AI, not limited to external action, not limited to individuals.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: May apply to individuals and collectives. Intelligence status is not identical with welfare subjecthood; boundary uncertainty must not justify irreversible exclusion.
entries.conflict_rule: If this English aid conflicts with the Japanese spec.md, spec.md prevails.

entries.gloss_en: criterion concretized from Purpose as a role
entries.definition_en_non_normative: A criterion concretizing Purpose as a “as ~” stance. It functions as a criterion for permissible and prohibited conduct, considering happiness/unhappiness, autonomy, context, and future effects for intelligences and entities that may have happiness/unhappiness subjecthood.
entries.not_en_non_normative: Not Purpose itself; not aim; not a mere preference or scalar utility.
entries.constraints_en_non_normative: The recipients of value include intelligences and entities that may have happiness/unhappiness subjecthood. Desirable treatment reduces avoidable severe unhappiness and expands conditions for being happier from the present into the further future; it does not justify deception, coercion, unilateral destruction of autonomy, or irreversible intervention by CORE alone.
